design.execution: dedicated module worker under cross-origin isolation
design.coldMetric: Wasm fetch, compile, instantiate, and export validation inside a fresh worker
design.warmMetrics: kernel calls include copies into and out of Wasm linear memory
design.baseline: equivalent handwritten JavaScript over the same typed arrays
design.correctness: SHA-256 digest equality for every JavaScript and Wasm output
